chart.description: The Chart entity the comment is on (its TypeId, chart-<uuid>).

target.description: The element it is about: a participant or message id; absent = the whole chart.

screenshot.description: An image the reviewer attached or pasted.

status.description: open: saved, not sent; submitted: sent to the building session; addressed: the chart was revised for it.

session.description: The agentic process the comment is sent to on Submit.
